section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1987
title: Accidental Deaths in India
notes: 1.6.1 The accidental deaths reported during 1987 have been further analysed
according to age-group of victims. On all-India level, the highest number
of accidental deaths occured in the age-group of 18-30 years which accounted
for 36.2% of the total accidental deaths followed by 30-50 years age-group
which accounted for 30.9% of the total accidental deaths. 18.9% of the
total accidental deaths occured in the age-group of below 18 years and
14.0% deaths were recorded in the age-group of above 50 years.
1.6.2 The distribution of accidental deaths according to age-group in the
States as a whole did not vary much from the all-India figures and this
distribution followed generally the same pattern in the Union Territories
